thread:
Priya Rao: Draft of the product post for Redwood Optimize is up — https://drive.redwood/optimize-launch-draft. Need quick pass on claims, benchmark callouts, webinar blurb, and inbound form mapping. Target publish: Tue 11am PT. Can we get signoffs by EOD Fri?

Jordan Kim: skimmed — looks strong. two quick q: hero stat source? and do we have a short one-line CTA for the webinar?

Samir Patel: hero stat comes from internal perf run across 4 customer workloads (agg). I can drop a short methods note. recommend phrasing: "up to 35% lower per-token cost on steady-state chat workloads" (we should keep the caveat).

Elena Gomez: design needs hero image sizes and an optional demo gif. @Priya can you confirm final headline so I can produce variations? also need brand-approved color for the chart.

Avery Chen: inbound routing — we should map webinar regs -> HubSpot form "optimize_launch_webinar" and set UTM source=blog, campaign=optimize_launch, medium=organic. Also propose a hidden field for "interest:dedicated" so SDRs can route.

Priya Rao: copying checklist I'm planning to run before publish: 
```
- Finalize hero stat + method blurb
- Legal claim signoff
- Design assets (hero + social)
- Embed webinar CTA + HubSpot form mapping
- UTM & campaign setup
- Publish time + embargo check
- A/B headline (optional)
```
If folks can reply with approvals or blockers by EOD Friday I'll lock it in.

Samir Patel: on benchmark callout — i'll paste a 2-sentence methods box under 'benchmarks' section and attach the perf script snippets. also recommend we include a short note on quantization config used.

Jordan Kim: suggested webinar CTA: "See how we cut inference cost — Join the Optimize launch webinar (Mar 9, 10am PT)". short and actionable.

LegalBot: flagged — please attach test logs for the hero claim and the quantization config. we need a named owner for data retention statements. tentative approval pending artifacts.

Avery Chen: will create the HubSpot form and set up UTMs in the campaign doc. tagging @OpsBot for publish timing and CDN invalidation window.

OpsBot: planned publish window Tue 11:00 PT. I'll schedule CDN invalidation at +5m and rollback playbook attached: /runbooks/publish-rollback. Confirm final assets by Mon 5pm.

Elena Gomez: ack — will send hero + social snippets by Mon 3pm. leaning toward subtle motion in hero gif to show throughput improvement.

Samir Patel: uploaded perf snippet: ```python
# run perf harness
results = run_benchmarks(models=["redwood-7b-q"], seq_len=512)
print(results.summary())
```
Attach will be in drive.

Priya Rao: leaving a small editorial ask — two headline options for A/B: 
A) "Optimize Inference: Cut Cost, Keep Latency"
B) "Smarter Batching, Lower Bills: Meet Optimize"
Which do we prefer for SEO?

Jordan Kim: lean A for clarity/SEO. B is snappier for social. we can A/B test. :thumbsup:

LegalBot: reviewed attached logs. hero claim language approved if we append: "based on internal benchmarks run by Redwood Inference using customer-like traces; results may vary". legal signs off on this phrasing.

Avery Chen: HubSpot form created and mapped to campaign. UTM snippet for links: `?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=optimize_launch`. I'll also add the hidden routing field.

Priya Rao: excellent — thanks everyone. locking publish Tue 11am PT. I'll drop final asset folder and the trimmed methods note by Mon 6pm. consider this thread the single source of truth for signoffs.

Jordan Kim: thanks — will prep the social copy once final headline is locked.

Elena Gomez: final assets uploaded.

OpsBot: publish window confirmed and CDN invalidation scheduled.

Priya Rao: Final check: Legal approved, Design uploaded, HubSpot mapped, Ops scheduled, Product attached perf notes — anyone object to me marking this approved?

Samir Patel: no objections, approved.

Jordan Kim: approved.

Avery Chen: approved.

LegalBot: approved (see note above).

Priya Rao: thanks team — marking as approved and moving to publish checklist. :rocket:
